faqs.q: Who should consider the IDFC FIRST Business Max Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card is ideal for small business owners, freelancers, and startups who may not qualify for unsecured business cards. Since it is backed by a fixed deposit starting at Rs. 10,000, it helps consumers build business credit while availing lifetime free card benefits and low finance charges of 12% p.a.

faqs.q: How rewarding is the card for regular business spending?
faqs.a: Cardholders can earn 6 reward points per Rs. 200 spent on domestic online purchases and 4 reward points on offline transactions. UPI payments above Rs. 2,000 earn 3 points per Rs. 200.

faqs.q: Does the card offer any travel-related benefits for business owners?
faqs.a: Yes, the card comes with a low forex markup fee of 1.5%, making international transactions more affordable. Consumers can also get 20% bonus reward points on hotel bookings and 10% bonus reward points on flight bookings made through the IDFC FIRST Bank mobile app.

faqs.q: Are there any annual or joining charges on the card?
faqs.a: No, the IDFC FIRST Business Max Credit Card is completely lifetime free with zero joining and annual fees.

faqs.q: Can purchases be converted into EMIs with this card?
faqs.a: Yes, transactions above Rs. 1,500 can be converted into easy EMIs.
